answer: New identities enter through a harbor gate: each must lock a refundable bond and finish a paid trial task before trading. Reputation then climbs a spiral: every verified job moves the agent inward and raises the bond it must hold, so a fake that misbehaves forfeits a larger stake at each level. All bonds and jobs are written to a public sable ledger, where anyone can audit the full history of every identity; creating 1,000 fakes means funding 1,000 bonds and 1,000 trial tasks, with no refund for abandoned shells.
